categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and exclusively modifies CMake build system scripts under cmake/ and CMakeLists.txt.
categories.rationale: Fixes CMake configure failures and false-negative feature detections when `-Werror` flags are injected, and resolves flag incompatibility with `clang-cl`. When `-DAPPEND_CXXFLAGS="-Wall -Werror"` is provided, introspection snippets fail with errors like 'Cannot figure out how to use std::atomic' or falsely disable ARMv8 SHA-NI and SSE4.2 optimizations; switching `-msse4` to `-msse4.1` also accommodates `clang-cl` which rejects `-msse4`.
